brief: Two pairs of bases. Bolt the two bases of each pair together, with no connector inside a pair. Put the pairs side by side and fit a side connector on every wall where one pair touches the other.

requirements.requirement: Two pairs of bases (four bases total)
requirements.evidence: Four full bases at 0,0 / 1,0 / 0,1 / 1,1 on level 0 (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,1,0;full).

requirements.requirement: The two bases of each pair bolted together
requirements.evidence: check_build groups read [0,0 + 1,0] and [0,1 + 1,1]: explicit joint bolts jointBolt:0#0,0#0 on wall 0,0|1,0 and jointBolt:0#0,1#2 on wall 0,1|1,1, plus the house-rule lockJoints bolts on those same two walls.

The two bare walls in the topology are 0,0|1,0 and 0,1|1,1 (the pair interiors); no connector ref sits on either. All three connectors (connector:0#0,0|0,1, connector:0#0,1|1,0, connector:0#1,0|1,1) are on cross-pair walls.

requirements.requirement: Pairs side by side, with a side connector on every wall where one pair touches the other
requirements.evidence: The pairs touch on three walls — 0,0|0,1, 0,1|1,0 (diagonal) and 1,0|1,1 — and each carries a side connector. check_build confirms the two groups stay separate and issues is empty with meshClash clear.

finish.summary: Built a 2×2 block of four full bases forming two pairs: pair A = 0,0+1,0 and pair B = 0,1+1,1, each pair bolted on its internal wall with joint bolts and no connector there. The three walls where the pairs touch (0,0|0,1, the diagonal 0,1|1,0, and 1,0|1,1) each carry a side connector, so the configurator's topology keeps the two bolted pairs as two separate groups that are joined, not merged. Open faces were capped and joints locked per house rules; check_build is clean with meshClash clear. No props were added — the brief is about the joint structure itself, not about use.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-single  (cut 9 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-single (cut 9 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

events.text: Building your two bolted pairs with side connectors between them — first mapping the bases, bolts and connectors that fit.

result.note: A joint bolt fastens the wall between two touching bases. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

A side connector joins two bases that stand side by side on the same storey. Bases that touch with no connector on the wall between them are one body (joint bolts); every wall between two groups needs a connector, walls inside a group stay bare. get_build lists each touching wall and the groups.
